name: @mui/mcp

tools.name: generateReactCode
tools.description: generates React + Material UI code from a natural-language prompt (optionally grounded in a Figma frame). Returns the generated files plus a short explanation. Requires `MUI_RECIPES_API_KEY`. Pass `threadId` back on subsequent calls to keep multi-turn conversations on the same chat. Pass `muiPairing` to target a specific MUI / MUI X major.

prompt.description: Natural-language brief for the codegen run.

threadId.description: Continue an existing conversation. Must be owned by the caller. Omit to start a new thread.

designContext.description: Design tool context. Use the `figma` variant when the host has a Figma frame in scope; `opaque` is the escape hatch for other tools (Penpot, Sketch, screenshots).

muiPairing.description: Target MUI / MUI X version pairing. Detect from the project's `package.json` (`@mui/material` and `@mui/x-data-grid` ranges) and pass accordingly. Omit to default to the latest stable pairing (currently Material UI v9 + MUI X v9).

material.description: Material UI major version. v8 was skipped; valid values are v5, v6, v7, v9.

model.description: Optional model override; otherwise the backend default.

tools.name: fetchDocs
tools.description: Fetch documentation for one or more URLs extracted from previous tool calls responses. The URLs should be passed as an array in the "urls" argument.

urls.description: The list of URLs to fetch documentation from
